patch.summary: Replace payment_method_types: ['card'] with allowed_payment_method_types and update the pinned Stripe API version.
patch.diff:
diff --git "a/lib/stripe.ts" "b/lib/stripe.ts"
--- "a/lib/stripe.ts"
+++ "b/lib/stripe.ts"
@@ -1,26 +1,26 @@
-import Stripe from 'stripe'
-
-export const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, {
-  apiVersion: '2026-02-25.clover',
-})
-
-export async function createCheckoutSession(userId: string, email: string): Promise<string> {
-  const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
-    mode: 'subscription',
-    payment_method_types: ['card'],
-    customer_email: email,
-    line_items: [{ price: process.env.STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID!, quantity: 1 }],
-    success_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/dashboard?upgraded=true`,
-    cancel_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/dashboard`,
-    metadata: { userId },
-  })
-  return session.url!
-}
-
-export async function createPortalSession(customerId: string): Promise<string> {
-  const session = await stripe.billingPortal.sessions.create({
-    customer: customerId,
-    return_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/dashboard`,
-  })
-  return session.url
-}
+import Stripe from 'stripe'
+
+export const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, {
+  apiVersion: '2026-09-30.endive',
+})
+
+export async function createCheckoutSession(userId: string, email: string): Promise<string> {
+  const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
+    mode: 'subscription',
+    allowed_payment_method_types: ['card'],
+    customer_email: email,
+    line_items: [{ price: process.env.STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID!, quantity: 1 }],
+    success_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/dashboard?upgraded=true`,
+    cancel_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/dashboard`,
+    metadata: { userId },
+  })
+  return session.url!
+}
+
+export async function createPortalSession(customerId: string): Promise<string> {
+  const session = await stripe.billingPortal.sessions.create({
+    customer: customerId,
+    return_url: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/dashboard`,
+  })
+  return session.url
+}
